title: Variance of the low-degree Fourier truncation
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, every Boolean function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and every degree cutoff $d\in\mathbb{N}$, the variance of the low-degree Fourier truncation of $f$ is at most the variance of $f$: $\operatorname{Var}(f^{\le d})\leq \operatorname{Var}(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube of dimension $n$
